en.ii.build.hint.step: Here is one part. You choose the rest.
en.ii.build.hint.reveal: Make it like this. Then test it.
en.ii.bridge.predict.instruction: Will the bridge hold? What do you think?
en.ii.bridge.predict.hint.model: Look at the plank. Look at the posts. Who is crossing?
en.ii.bridge.look.held: Look. It held. Tap what happened.
en.ii.bridge.look.sagged: Look. It sags. Tap what happened.
en.ii.bridge.build.instruction: This bridge sags. Change it so it holds.
en.ii.bridge.build.incorrect: It still sags. Change one thing and test again.
en.ii.bridge.build.hint.model: A thick plank holds more. Posts hold it up.
en.ii.ramp.predict.instruction: Where will the ball stop? What do you think?
en.ii.ramp.predict.hint.model: How high is the ramp? Is the ground rough or smooth?
en.ii.ramp.is.landed: Yes. It stopped on the star.
en.ii.ramp.look.landed: Look. It stopped on the star. Tap what happened.
en.ii.ramp.look.rolled-short: Look. It stopped too soon. Tap what happened.
en.ii.ramp.look.rolled-past: Look. It rolled too far. Tap what happened.
en.ii.ramp.build.instruction: Make the ball stop on the star.
en.ii.ramp.build.incorrect: Not on the star yet. Change one thing and test again.
en.ii.ramp.build.hint.model: A higher ramp rolls it further. Rough ground slows it down.
en.ii.balance.predict.instruction: Which way will it tip? What do you think?
en.ii.balance.predict.hint.model: Count the blocks. Look how far out they are.
en.ii.balance.is.tipped-left: Yes. The blue side went down.
en.ii.balance.is.tipped-right: Yes. The orange side went down.
en.ii.balance.look.balanced: Look. It balanced. Tap what happened.
en.ii.balance.look.tipped-left: Look. The blue side went down. Tap what happened.
en.ii.balance.look.tipped-right: Look. The orange side went down. Tap what happened.
en.ii.balance.build.incorrect: It is still tipping. Change one thing and test again.
en.ii.balance.build.hint.model: Further out pushes down more. More blocks push down more.
en.ii.float.predict.instruction: Will it float or sink? What do you think?
en.ii.float.predict.hint.model: What is it made of? Big things can float. Small things can sink.
en.ii.float.look.floated: Look. It floats. Tap what happened.
en.ii.float.look.sank: Look. It sank. Tap what happened.
en.ii.boat.build.instruction: Take all the stones across. Do not let the boat sink.
en.ii.boat.build.incorrect: Not yet. Change one thing and test again.
en.ii.boat.build.hint.model: A bigger boat can carry more. Too many stones and it sinks.

skills.title: Guess whether a bridge will hold
skills.objective: Looks at a plank bridge — how wide the gap, how thick the plank, how many posts, who is crossing — and says whether it will hold before it is tested.

skills.title: Mend a bridge that sags
skills.objective: Changes a bridge that sags, by a thicker plank or by posts, until it holds, testing after each change.

skills.title: Guess where a rolling ball will stop
skills.objective: Looks at how high a ramp is and whether the ground is rough or smooth, and says whether the ball will stop short of the star, on it or past it.

skills.title: Set a ramp so the ball stops on the star
skills.objective: Changes the height of a ramp and the ground it rolls onto until the ball stops where it is wanted, testing after each change.

skills.title: Guess which way a beam will tip
skills.objective: Looks at how many blocks are on each side of a beam and how far out they are, and says which side will go down or that it will balance.

skills.title: Make a beam balance
skills.objective: Places blocks on one side of a beam to balance the other, using both how many and how far out.

skills.title: Guess what floats and what sinks
skills.objective: Says whether a thing will float or sink before it is dropped in water, going by what it is made of and not by how big it is; and whether a loaded boat will float.

skills.title: Choose a boat that carries the load
skills.objective: Carries stones across a pond by choosing a boat big enough and loading it with all of them and no more than it can bear.

lessons.title: Bridges that hold
lessons.summary: A plank across a gap, and someone who wants to cross. Your child guesses whether it will hold and watches it tested, then mends a bridge that sags by changing the plank or standing posts under it.

lessons.title: Ramps and rolling
lessons.summary: A ball rolls down a ramp and on along the ground. Your child guesses where it will stop, then makes it stop on the star by changing how high the ramp is and whether the ground is rough or smooth.

lessons.title: Balancing
lessons.summary: Blocks on a beam that rests on its middle. Your child guesses which way it will tip, then puts blocks on the other side to make it balance, and finds that one block far out can balance three close in.

lessons.title: Float or sink
lessons.summary: Things are dropped in a tub of water: your child guesses float or sink, and then sees. Big things can float and small things can sink; it is what a thing is made of that counts. Then stones, which sink, are carried across a pond in a boat that must not go under.
